supportedFindings.finding: Table II lists seven residential or business wells on Plett Road, Section 34, Haring Township, among cases possibly attributable to road brining; it also lists Cadillac and Cedar Creek Township residences.
supportedFindings.boundary: Possible attribution only; not proof of source, not PFAS, not current conditions, and not identification of the 1140 Plett Road receptor.

supportedFindings.finding: Table III estimates 11,947,110 gallons used for 1982 road maintenance in the Cadillac Geological Survey District.
supportedFindings.boundary: The district is a regional administrative unit, not the City of Cadillac; the report characterizes the data as estimated and conservative.

supportedFindings.finding: The report describes suspected long-term low-level groundwater effects and recommends stronger coordination, written contracts, monitoring, enforcement and centralized records.
supportedFindings.boundary: The report expressly says proof of the suspected statewide trend did not then exist; recommendations are not evidence of implementation.

status.verificationScope: Source identity, page coverage and cited statements are verified against the supplied record; historical assertions were not independently re-proven.
